_comment: DRY RUN — mtf_asia_0000_0230__sg on 5 MNQ, 00:00-02:30 ET (founder 2026-10-01: "enable this instead of" ICHIMOKU_1M_FAST, which is archived in config/archived/). Mirrors the paper twin: MTF scalper defaults + session_window 0000-0230, vwap_anchor session_window, spread_gate_rel 1.5 (the __sg book gate, live-runnable on the pg feed), qty_max 3 in the twin — run at 5 here on the founder's word (qty = qty_max = min_qty = 5); compare per contract, max_daily_trades 20 (the MTF default the paper twin runs with — it took 14-16 trades a night). Risk knobs = the paper engine orb_config_for base. Record before enabling: 4 nights (09-23..25 replay, 09-25 + 10-01 forward), +125 pts per contract, 10-01 alone = 60% of it. dry_run → no Rithmic session, nothing sent, label gets _dry. allow_flips false: required live (the executor cannot reverse a position in one step) — the one rule difference from the paper twin: a reversal signal exits instead of flipping. warmup_minutes 3200: the MTF needs warmup_bars 1500 one-minute bars before it trades, so a restart must replay enough history to be warm before the 00:00 session.
